thread:
maria.g: Heads-up — we plan to shift 10% staging traffic to the new eu-west-proxy (rotterdam) tomorrow 09:00 UTC. I need quick ownership confirmation for TLS termination, egress routing, and the data-residency checklist. Who's on deck?

sunil.k: I can own TLS termination + certs. I already uploaded the cert chain to Vault and created a PR to reference it in the proxy helm values: https://git.redwood/infra/proxy/merge_requests/482. Tested locally with `curl --resolve` and it looks fine.

jordan: I can take load and smoke tests during the shift. Will run the canary harness and watch qps/latency. Can you post the exact canary percentages and the rollback window?

maria.g: Thanks — plan is 10% at t0, 50% at t+15m if green, then 100% at t+30m if still green. Rollback window is 10m after each step. Addtional check: confirm KV cache warm-up is enabled for model-serving routes in that region.

anya: Who owns egress peering + S3 residency for logs? We need to ensure logs from rotterdam stay in EU buckets and egress routes don't hit US NAT. Also CDN invalidation needs an owner.

marco: That's on me for egress peering + residency. I've validated the VPC peering and created a terraform plan that pins S3 endpoints to the eu bucket. PR: https://git.redwood/net/terraform/merge_requests/291. CDN invalidation — pinging @anya to confirm cache invalidation TTLs; we probably want a short TTL for the first hour.

anya: Confirmed. Set CDN TTL override to 60s for the shift window. I'll trigger invalidation after the 50% step if things look stable.

sunil.k: Quick ops note — proxy sidecar image will be rolled to v1.12.3 in rotterdam as part of the shift. The image includes the TLS bugfix. Helm patch I ran locally: ```helm upgrade proxy ./charts/proxy -f values-eu.yml --set image.tag=v1.12.3```

ops-bot: job scheduled: canary-shift-rotterdam — started by maria.g — start=2026-03-18T09:00:00Z — runbook=/runbooks/region-shift.md — notify=#eng-oncall,#eng-platform

jordan: For observability, I'll watch these metrics: proxy_success_rate, edge_latency_p50/p95, origin_egress_bytes, model_kv_hit_rate. Can someone add the dashboard link?

maria.g: Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/d/region-shift/rotterdam-canary. Add it to the runbook and the ops playbook before 08:30 UTC.

marco: One blocker: DRT (disaster recovery) playbook needs a small update — the secondary failover path currently points to nl1, but for GDPR reasons we should ensure failover keeps data in EU-only zones. I'll push a quick patch to the DR doc and alert SRE.

anya: Also double-check IAM role scoping for the proxy service account — staging roles should not have cross-region S3 write. I'll audit and post findings before 08:45 UTC.

sunil.k: All certs are valid and non-expiring for 90 days. I also added a healthcheck to the helm chart: `livenessProbe: exec: ["/bin/probe", "tls"]` so we fail fast if TLS is misconfigured.

maria.g: Great. Action items: (1) sunil — merge cert PR and helm patch before 08:40, (2) marco — merge terraform plan and DR doc updates before 08:45, (3) anya — CDN TTL + IAM audit before 08:45, (4) jordan — be on-call for canary and announce rollback if p95 > 400ms or model_kv_hit_rate drops >20%. I'll kick things off at 09:00.

jordan: Roger. I'll post periodic updates in this thread during the shift. :thumbsup:

maria.g: Thanks team — if anything unexpected, @eng-oncall please jump in.

ops-bot: alert: canary-shift-rotterdam scheduled to start in 30 minutes. Reminder: slack thread pinned to runbook.
